node -e "const fs=require('fs');const content=`// ================================================================
//  LiveSession \u2014 the notebook's \"one live machine\" (R1 + R2)
//
//  Implements docs/NOTEBOOK_SEMANTICS.md:
//   - one machine per notebook, state persists across cell runs
//   - cells are source regions of ONE assembled program
//   - \u25B6 on a cell = bring the CPU to the cell start, execute through
//     the cell end, leave the machine live at the cursor
//   - edits re-assemble; the machine continues when provably safe,
//     otherwise it is visibly marked \`restart-needed\` (never silently
//     inconsistent)
//
//  R2 adds: @expect checkable assertions, friendly errors,
//  register/flag hover docs, lesson metadata.
//
//  DOM-free and Node-testable (tests/session.test.ts).
// ================================================================
import { CPU, Parser, Executor } from './engine.mjs';
import { parseExpects, evaluateExpects, type ExpectResult, type EvalContext } from './expect.js';
import { friendlyErrors, type FriendlyError } from './errors.js';

export type CellKind = 'code' | 'markdown';

export interface Cell {
  id: string;
  kind: CellKind;
  source: string;
}

export interface RunResult {
  reason: 'cell-end' | 'halted' | 'breakpoint' | 'cap' | 'left-cell' | 'reached' | 'end' | 'restart-needed' | 'error';
  error?: string;
  steps: number;
  output: string;
  regDiff: Record<string, [number, number]>;
  halted: boolean;
  expectResults: ExpectResult[];
  allPassed: boolean;
}

export interface CellOutput {
  text: string;
  regDiff: Record<string, [number, number]>;
  steps: number;
  reason: RunResult['reason'];
  stale: boolean;
  expectResults: ExpectResult[];
  allPassed: boolean;
}

const REG_LIST = ['AX', 'BX', 'CX', 'DX', 'SI', 'DI', 'BP', 'SP'];

export interface LiveState {
  regs: Record<string, number>;
  flags: Record<string, number>;
  cursor: { cellId: string | null; line: number | null; instrIndex: number } | null;
  halted: boolean;
  needsRestart: boolean;
  totalInstrs: number;
}

export class LiveSession {
  private cells: Cell[] = [];
  private cpu = new CPU();
  private ex = new Executor();
  private outputs = new Map<string, CellOutput>();
  private needsRestart = false;
  private built = false;
  private parsed: any = null;
  private starts: number[] = [];
  private lineOwner: string[] = [];
  private bpSource = new Set<string>();
  private breakpoints = new Set<number>();
  private expectsByCell = new Map<string, ReturnType<typeof parseExpects>>();
  private cellBase: number = 0x100;

  setCells(cells: Cell[]): { needsRestart: boolean } {
    const r = this.rebuild(cells);
    this.needsRestart = r.needsRestart;
    return r;
  }

  private rebuild(cells: Cell[]): { needsRestart: boolean } {
    this.cells = cells;
    this.outputs.clear();
    this.expectsByCell.clear();
    const codeCells = cells.filter(c => c.kind === 'code');
    const parts: string[] = [];
    this.starts = [];
    this.lineOwner = [];
    for (const c of codeCells) {
      this.starts.push(parts.length + 1);
      const lines = c.source.split('\\n');
      for (const ln of lines) { this.lineOwner.push(c.id); parts.push(ln); }
    }
    const concat = parts.join('\\n');
    this.parsed = new Parser().parse(concat);
    for (const c of codeCells) {
      this.expectsByCell.set(c.id, parseExpects(c.source));
    }
    this.built = true;
    const prevIP = this.cpu.ip;
    this.ex = new Executor();
    this.ex.load(this.parsed.instrs, { base: this.cellBase });
    this.cpu = new CPU();
    this.cpu.setMem(0, 0, 8);
    this.ex.bind(this.cpu);
    this.resyncBreakpoints();
    if (prevIP < this.parsed.instrs.length && this.parsed.instrs[prevIP]) {
      this.cpu.ip = prevIP;
      return { needsRestart: false };
    }
    return { needsRestart: true };
  }

  get cellCount(): number { return this.cells.length; }
  get instrCount(): number { return this.parsed?.instrs?.length ?? 0; }

  runCell(cellId: string): RunResult {
    return this.run(cellId, 'cell-end');
  }

  runUpTo(cellId: string): RunResult {
    this.resetMachine(false);
    return this.run(cellId, 'cell-end');
  }

  private run(targetCellId: string, mode: 'cell-end'): RunResult {
    if (!this.built) return this.emptyResult('error', 'No program built yet');
    if (this.needsRestart) return this.emptyResult('restart-needed', 'The machine needs a restart because a cell above was edited');
    const targetIdx = this.cells.findIndex(c => c.id === targetCellId && c.kind === 'code');
    if (targetIdx < 0) return this.emptyResult('error', 'No such code cell');
    const before = this.snapshotRegs();
    const outBuf: string[] = [];
    this.cpu.intOutput = (s: string) => outBuf.push(s);
    const cellEndLine = targetIdx + 1 < this.starts.length ? this.starts[targetIdx + 1] - 1 : Infinity;
    let steps = 0;
    const CAP = 200000;
    let reason: RunResult['reason'] = 'cell-end';
    while (steps < CAP) {
      const ip = this.cpu.ip;
      if (ip >= this.parsed.instrs.length) { reason = 'end'; break; }
      const ins = this.parsed.instrs[ip];
      const curLine = ins.lineNum;
      if (curLine > cellEndLine) { reason = 'left-cell'; break; }
      if (this.breakpoints.has(ip)) { reason = 'breakpoint'; break; }
      this.ex.step();
      steps++;
      if (this.cpu.halted) { reason = 'halted'; break; }
    }
    if (steps >= CAP) reason = 'cap';
    const after = this.snapshotRegs();
    const regDiff = diffRegs(before, after);
    const output = outBuf.join('');
    const expectResults = this.evalExpects(targetCellId);
    const result: RunResult = {
      reason, steps, output, regDiff, halted: !!this.cpu.halted,
      expectResults, allPassed: expectResults.every(r => r.passed)
    };
    this.outputs.set(targetCellId, {
      text: output, regDiff, steps, reason, stale: false, expectResults, allPassed: result.allPassed
    });
    return result;
  }

  private resetMachine(clearBps = true) {
    this.cpu = new CPU();
    this.cpu.setMem(0, 0, 8);
    this.ex = new Executor();
    if (this.parsed) {
      this.ex.load(this.parsed.instrs, { base: this.cellBase });
      this.ex.bind(this.cpu);
    }
    if (clearBps) { this.bpSource.clear(); this.breakpoints.clear(); }
    else this.resyncBreakpoints();
    this.needsRestart = false;
  }

  step(): RunResult {
    if (!this.built) return this.emptyResult('error', 'No program built yet');
    if (this.needsRestart) return this.emptyResult('restart-needed', 'Restart needed');
    const ip = this.cpu.ip;
    if (ip >= this.parsed.instrs.length) return this.emptyResult('end', 'At end of program');
    const before = this.snapshotRegs();
    this.cpu.intOutput = (s: string) => {};
    this.ex.step();
    const after = this.snapshotRegs();
    const regDiff = diffRegs(before, after);
    const cellId = this.lineOwner[this.parsed.instrs[ip]?.lineNum - 1] ?? null;
    const expectResults = cellId ? this.evalExpects(cellId) : [];
    return { reason: this.cpu.halted ? 'halted' : 'cell-end', steps: 1, output: '', regDiff, halted: !!this.cpu.halted, expectResults, allPassed: expectResults.every(r => r.passed) };
  }

  continueRun(): RunResult {
    if (!this.built) return this.emptyResult('error', 'No program built yet');
    if (this.needsRestart) return this.emptyResult('restart-needed', 'Restart needed');
    const before = this.snapshotRegs();
    const outBuf: string[] = [];
    this.cpu.intOutput = (s: string) => outBuf.push(s);
    let steps = 0;
    const CAP = 200000;
    let reason: RunResult['reason'] = 'end';
    while (steps < CAP) {
      const ip = this.cpu.ip;
      if (ip >= this.parsed.instrs.length) { reason = 'end'; break; }
      if (this.breakpoints.has(ip)) { reason = 'breakpoint'; break; }
      this.ex.step();
      steps++;
      if (this.cpu.halted) { reason = 'halted'; break; }
    }
    if (steps >= CAP) reason = 'cap';
    const after = this.snapshotRegs();
    const regDiff = diffRegs(before, after);
    const ip = Math.min(this.cpu.ip, this.parsed.instrs.length - 1);
    const cellId = this.parsed.instrs[ip] ? this.lineOwner[this.parsed.instrs[ip].lineNum - 1] ?? null : null;
    const expectResults = cellId ? this.evalExpects(cellId) : [];
    return { reason, steps, output: outBuf.join(''), regDiff, halted: !!this.cpu.halted, expectResults, allPassed: expectResults.every(r => r.passed) };
  }

  private emptyResult(reason: RunResult['reason'], error: string): RunResult {
    return { reason, error, steps: 0, output: '', regDiff: {}, halted: false, expectResults: [], allPassed: true };
  }

  private snapshotRegs(): Record<string, number> {
    const r: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const k of [...REG_LIST, 'CS', 'DS', 'ES', 'SS']) r[k] = this.cpu.getReg(k);
    r['IP'] = this.cpu.ip;
    return r;
  }

  private evalCtx(): EvalContext {
    const cpu = this.cpu;
    const memRead = (addr: number, bits: number) => cpu.memRead(addr, bits);
    return {
      getReg: (n: string) => { try { return cpu.getReg(n.toUpperCase()); } catch { return null; } },
      getFlag: (n: string) => { const f = cpu.flags[n.toUpperCase()]; return typeof f === 'number' ? f & 1 : null; },
      memReadByte: (linear: number) => memRead(linear & 0xfffff, 8),
      getScreenChar: (row: number, col: number) => { const off = (row * 80 + col) * 2; return memRead(0xB8000 + off, 8); }
    };
  }

  evalExpects(cellId: string): ExpectResult[] {
    const clauses = this.expectsByCell.get(cellId) || [];
    if (clauses.length === 0) return [];
    return evaluateExpects(this.evalCtx(), clauses);
  }

  getFriendlyErrors(): FriendlyError[] {
    return friendlyErrors(this.getParseErrors());
  }

  toggleBreakpoint(cellId: string, lineInCell: number): boolean {
    const key = \`\${cellId}:\${lineInCell}\`;
    if (this.bpSource.has(key)) { this.bpSource.delete(key); this.resyncBreakpoints(); return false; }
    this.bpSource.add(key); this.resyncBreakpoints(); return true;
  }

  private resyncBreakpoints() {
    this.breakpoints.clear();
    for (const key of this.bpSource) {
      const [cid, ln] = key.split(':');
      const ci = this.cells.findIndex(c => c.id === cid);
      if (ci < 0) continue;
      const abs = this.starts[ci] + Number(ln) - 1;
      const idx = this.parsed.instrs.findIndex((ins: any) => ins.lineNum === abs);
      if (idx >= 0) this.breakpoints.add(idx);
    }
  }

  getBreakpointLines(cellId: string): Set<number> {
    const s = new Set<number>();
    for (const key of this.bpSource) { const [cid, ln] = key.split(':'); if (cid === cellId) s.add(Number(ln)); }
    return s;
  }

  getState(): LiveState {
    const ip = this.built ? this.cpu.ip : 0;
    const ins = this.built ? this.parsed.instrs[ip] : null;
    const line = ins ? ins.lineNum : null;
    const cellId = line ? this.lineOwner[line - 1] ?? null : null;
    return { regs: this.snapshotRegs(), flags: { ...this.cpu.flags }, cursor: this.built ? { cellId, line, instrIndex: ip } : null, halted: !!this.cpu.halted, needsRestart: this.needsRestart, totalInstrs: this.built ? this.parsed.instrs.length : 0 };
  }

  getOutput(cellId: string): CellOutput | undefined { return this.outputs.get(cellId); }
  getAllOutputs(): Map<string, CellOutput> { return new Map(this.outputs); }

  cellLineOffset(cellId: string): number | null {
    const ci = this.cells.findIndex(c => c.id === cellId);
    if (ci < 0) return null;
    return this.starts[ci];
  }

  getParseErrors(): { cellId: string | null; line: number | null; message: string }[] {
    return (this.parsed?.errors || []).map((e: any) => ({
      cellId: e.lineNum ? this.lineOwner[e.lineNum - 1] ?? null : null,
      line: e.lineNum ?? null,
      message: e.message
    }));
  }

  memHex(linear: number, rows = 8): { addr: number; bytes: number[] }[] {
    const out: { addr: number; bytes: number[] }[] = [];
    for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
      const addr = linear + r * 16;
      const bytes: number[] = [];
      for (let b = 0; b < 16; b++) bytes.push(this.cpu.memRead(addr + b, 8));
      out.push({ addr, bytes });
    }
    return out;
  }

  stackView(depth = 8): { sp: number; words: number[] } {
    const sp = this.cpu.getReg('SP');
    const linear = ((this.cpu.getReg('SS') << 4) + sp) & 0xFFFFF;
    const words: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < depth; i++) words.push(this.cpu.memRead(linear + i * 2, 16));
    return { sp, words };
  }

  screenText(): { ch: string; attr: number }[][] {
    const rows: { ch: string; attr: number }[][] = [];
    for (let r = 0; r < 25; r++) {
      const row: { ch: string; attr: number }[] = [];
      for (let c = 0; c < 80; c++) {
        const off = (r * 80 + c) * 2;
        const chCode = this.cpu.memRead(0xB8000 + off, 8);
        const attr = this.cpu.memRead(0xB8000 + off + 1, 8);
        row.push({ ch: String.fromCharCode(chCode), attr });
      }
      rows.push(row);
    }
    return rows;
  }
}

function diffRegs(before: Record<string, number>, after: Record<string, number>): Record<string, [number, number]> {
  const d: Record<string, [number, number]> = {};
  for (const k of Object.keys(after)) {
    if ((before[k] ?? 0) !== (after[k] ?? 0)) d[k] = [before[k] ?? 0, after[k] ?? 0];
  }
  return d;
}

// ================================================================
//  friendly errors â€” turn NASM/engine diagnostics into plain English
//  for the teaching layer (R2). Pure functions, DOM-free, testable.
// ================================================================

export interface FriendlyError {
  line: number | null;
  original: string;
  friendly: string;
  hint: string;
}

const NASM_PATTERNS: { re: RegExp; explain: (m: RegExpMatchArray) => { friendly: string; hint: string } }[] = [
  { re: /parser: error: (.+)/i, explain: m => ({ friendly: `The assembler couldn't understand: "${m[1]}".`, hint: 'Check the instruction name, register spelling, and operand order.' }) },
  { re: /error: (?:invalid|unknown) (?:combination of|instruction|mnemonic|register|operand)[:\s]*(.+)?/i, explain: m => ({ friendly: `Invalid instruction/operand${m[1] ? ` ("${m[1].trim()}")` : ''}.`, hint: 'Maybe the operands are the wrong size, or that form doesn\'t exist on the 8086.' }) },
  { re: /error: (?:symbol|label) ['"]?(.+?)['"]? (?:redefined|already defined)/i, explain: m => ({ friendly: `The name "${m[1].trim()}" is used more than once.`, hint: 'Each label must have a unique name.' }) },
  { re: /error: (?:symbol|label) ['"]?(.+?)['"]? (?:not defined|undefined|is undefined)/i, explain: m => ({ friendly: `The name "${m[1].trim()}" is used but never defined.`, hint: 'Did you spell the label the same way when you defined it?' }) },
  { re: /error: (?:short|near|far) jump (?:out of range|is out of range)/i, explain: _ => ({ friendly: 'A jump tries to go too far.', hint: 'Use a closer jump target or restructure the code.' }) },
  { re: /error: .*/i, explain: m => ({ friendly: `Assembler error: ${m[0]}.`, hint: 'Look at this line for typos.' }) }
];

const RUNTIME_PATTERNS: { re: RegExp; explain: (m: RegExpMatchArray) => { friendly: string; hint: string } }[] = [
  { re: /divide (?:by zero|overflow)/i, explain: _ => ({ friendly: 'The CPU tried to divide by zero.', hint: 'Make sure the divisor is not zero before DIV/IDIV.' }) },
  { re: /infinite loop/i, explain: _ => ({ friendly: 'The program ran a very long time without stopping.', hint: 'Does every loop have a way to end?' }) }
];

function matchError(text: string, patterns: typeof NASM_PATTERNS): { friendly: string; hint: string } | null {
  for (const p of patterns) {
    const m = text.match(p.re);
    if (m) return p.explain(m);
  }
  return null;
}

export function friendlyParse(text: string, line: number | null): FriendlyError {
  const txt = text.trim();
  const nas = matchError(txt, NASM_PATTERNS);
  if (nas) return { line, original: txt, friendly: nas.friendly, hint: nas.hint };
  const run = matchError(txt, RUNTIME_PATTERNS);
  if (run) return { line, original: txt, friendly: run.friendly, hint: run.hint };
  const truncated = txt.length > 60 ? txt.slice(0, 57) + 'â€¦' : txt;
  return { line, original: txt, friendly: `Something went wrong: "${truncated}".`, hint: 'Look at the flagged line.' };
  return { line, original: txt, friendly: `Something went wrong: "${txt.length > 60 ? txt.slice(0, 57) + 'â€¦' : txt}".`, hint: 'Look at the flagged line.' });
  return errors.map(e => friendlyParse(e.message, e.line));
}

export class LiveSession {
  private cells: Cell[] = [];
  private cpu = new CPU();
  private ex = new Executor();
  private outputs = new Map();
  private needsRestart = false;
  private built = false;
  private parsed = null;
  private starts = [];
  private lineOwner = [];
  private bpSource = new Set();
  private breakpoints = new Set();
  private expectsByCell = new Map();
  private cellBase = 0x100;

  setCells(cells) {
    const r = this.rebuild(cells);
    this.needsRestart = r.needsRestart;
    return r;
  }

  rebuild(cells) {
    this.cells = cells;
    this.outputs.clear();
    this.expectsByCell.clear();
    const codeCells = cells.filter(c => c.kind === 'code');
    const parts = [];
    this.starts = [];
    this.lineOwner = [];
    for (const c of codeCells) {
      this.starts.push(parts.length + 1);
      for (const ln of c.source.split('\n')) { this.lineOwner.push(c.id); parts.push(ln); }
    }
    this.parsed = new Parser().parse(parts.join('\n'));
    for (const c of codeCells) {
      this.expectsByCell.set(c.id, parseExpects(c.source));
    }
    this.built = true;
    const prevIP = this.cpu.ip;
    this.ex = new Executor();
    this.ex.load(this.parsed.instrs, { base: this.cellBase });
    this.cpu = new CPU();
    this.cpu.setMem(0, 0, 8);
    this.ex.bind(this.cpu);
    this.resyncBreakpoints();
    if (prevIP < this.parsed.instrs.length && this.parsed.instrs[prevIP]) {
      this.cpu.ip = prevIP;
      return { needsRestart: false };
    }
    return { needsRestart: true };
  }

  get cellCount() { return this.cells.length; }
  get instrCount() { return this.parsed ? this.parsed.instrs.length : 0; }

  runCell(cellId) { return this.run(cellId); }

  runUpTo(cellId) {
    this.resetMachine(false);
    return this.run(cellId);
  }

  run(targetCellId) {
    if (!this.built) return this.emptyResult('error', 'No program built yet');
    if (this.needsRestart) return this.emptyResult('restart-needed', 'The machine needs a restart');
    const targetIdx = this.cells.findIndex(c => c.id === targetCellId && c.kind === 'code');
    if (targetIdx < 0) return this.emptyResult('error', 'No such code cell');
    const before = this.snapshotRegs();
    const outBuf = [];
    this.cpu.intOutput = (s) => outBuf.push(s);

// ================================================================
//  LiveSession — the notebook's "one live machine" (R1 + R2)
//
//  Implements docs/NOTEBOOK_SEMANTICS.md:
//   - one machine per notebook, state persists across cell runs
//   - cells are source regions of ONE assembled program
//   - ▶ on a cell = bring the CPU to the cell start, execute through
//     the cell end, leave the machine live at the cursor
//   - edits re-assemble; the machine continues when provably safe,
//     otherwise it is visibly marked `restart-needed` (never silently
//     inconsistent)
//
//  R2 adds: @expect checkable assertions, friendly errors,
//  register/flag hover docs, lesson metadata.
//
//  DOM-free and Node-testable (tests/session.test.ts).
// ================================================================
import { CPU, Parser, Executor } from './engine.mjs';
import { parseExpects, evaluateExpects } from './expect.js';
import type { ExpectResult, EvalContext } from './expect.js';
import { friendlyErrors } from './errors.js';
import type { FriendlyError } from './errors.js';

export type CellKind = 'code' | 'markdown';

export interface Cell {
  id: string;
  kind: CellKind;
  source: string;
}

export interface RunResult {
  reason: 'cell-end' | 'halted' | 'breakpoint' | 'cap' | 'left-cell' | 'reached' | 'end' | 'restart-needed' | 'error';
  error?: string;
  steps: number;
  output: string;

  allPassed: boolean;
}

  text: string;
  regDiff: Record<string, [number, number]>;
  steps: number;
  reason: RunResult['reason'];
  stale: boolean;
  expectResults: ExpectResult[];
  allPassed: boolean;
}

export interface LiveState {
  regs: Record<string, number>;
  flags: Record<string, number>;
  cursor: { cellId: string | null; line: number | null; instrIndex: number } | null;
  halted: boolean;
  needsRestart: boolean;
  totalInstrs: number;
}

const REG_LIST = ['AX', 'BX', 'CX', 'DX', 'SI', 'DI', 'BP', 'SP'];

function diffRegs(before: Record<string, number>, after: Record<string, number>): Record<string, [number, number]> {
  const d: Record<string, [number, number]> = {};
  for (const k of Object.keys(after)) {
    if ((before[k] ?? 0) !== (after[k] ?? 0)) d[k] = [before[k] ?? 0, after[k] ?? 0];
  }
  return d;
}

export class LiveSession {
  private cells: Cell[] = [];
  private cpu = new CPU();
  private ex = new Executor();
  private outputs = new Map<string, CellOutput>();
  private needsRestart = false;
  private built = false;
  private parsed: any = null;
  private starts: number[] = [];
  private lineOwner: string[] = [];
  private bpSource = new Set<string>();
  private breakpoints = new Set<number>();
  private expectsByCell = new Map<string, ReturnType<typeof parseExpects>>();
  private cellBase = 0x100;

  setCells(cells: Cell[]): { needsRestart: boolean } {
    const r = this.rebuild(cells);
    this.needsRestart = r.needsRestart;
    return r;
  }

  private rebuild(cells: Cell[]): { needsRestart: boolean } {
    this.cells = cells;
    this.outputs.clear();
    this.expectsByCell.clear();
    const codeCells = cells.filter(c => c.kind === 'code');
    const parts: string[] = [];
    this.starts = [];
    this.lineOwner = [];
    for (const c of codeCells) {
      this.starts.push(parts.length + 1);
      const lines = c.source.split('\n');
      for (const ln of lines) { this.lineOwner.push(c.id); parts.push(ln); }
    }
    const concat = parts.join('\n');
    this.parsed = new Parser().parse(concat);
    for (const c of codeCells) {
      this.expectsByCell.set(c.id, parseExpects(c.source));
    }
    this.built = true;
    const prevIP = this.cpu.ip;
    this.ex = new Executor();
    this.ex.load(this.parsed.instrs, { base: this.cellBase });
    this.cpu = new CPU();
    this.cpu.setMem(0, 0, 8);
    this.ex.bind(this.cpu);
    this.resyncBreakpoints();
    if (prevIP < this.parsed.instrs.length && this.parsed.instrs[prevIP]) {
      this.cpu.ip = prevIP;
      return { needsRestart: false };
    }
    return { needsRestart: true };
  }

  get cellCount(): number { return this.cells.length; }
  get instrCount(): number { return this.parsed?.instrs?.length ?? 0; }

  runCell(cellId: string): RunResult {
    return this.run(cellId);
  }

  runUpTo(cellId: string): RunResult {
    this.resetMachine(false);
    return this.run(cellId);
  }

  private run(targetCellId: string): RunResult {
    if (!this.built) return this.emptyResult('error', 'No program built yet');
    if (this.needsRestart) return this.emptyResult('restart-needed', 'The machine needs a restart because a cell above was edited');
    const targetIdx = this.cells.findIndex(c => c.id === targetCellId && c.kind === 'code');
    if (targetIdx < 0) return this.emptyResult('error', 'No such code cell');
    const before = this.snapshotRegs();
    const outBuf: string[] = [];
    this.cpu.intOutput = (s: string) => outBuf.push(s);
    const cellEndLine = targetIdx + 1 < this.starts.length ? this.starts[targetIdx + 1] - 1 : Infinity;
    let steps = 0;
    const CAP = 200000;
    let reason: RunResult['reason'] = 'cell-end';
    while (steps < CAP) {
      const ip = this.cpu.ip;
      if (ip >= this.parsed.instrs.length) { reason = 'end'; break; }
      const curLine = this.parsed.instrs[ip].lineNum;
      if (curLine > cellEndLine) { reason = 'left-cell'; break; }
      if (this.breakpoints.has(ip)) { reason = 'breakpoint'; break; }
      this.ex.step();
      steps++;
      if (this.cpu.halted) { reason = 'halted'; break; }
    }
    if (steps >= CAP) reason = 'cap';
    const after = this.snapshotRegs();
    const regDiff = diffRegs(before, after);
    const output = outBuf.join('');
    const expectResults = this.evalExpects(targetCellId);
    const result: RunResult = {
      reason, steps, output, regDiff, halted: !!this.cpu.halted,
      expectResults, allPassed: expectResults.every(r => r.passed)
    };
    this.outputs.set(targetCellId, {
      text: output, regDiff, steps, reason, stale: false, expectResults, allPassed: result.allPassed
    });
    return result;
  }

  private resetMachine(clearBps = true) {
    this.cpu = new CPU();
    this.cpu.setMem(0, 0, 8);
    this.ex = new Executor();
    if (this.parsed) {
      this.ex.load(this.parsed.instrs, { base: this.cellBase });
      this.ex.bind(this.cpu);
    }
    if (clearBps) { this.bpSource.clear(); this.breakpoints.clear(); }
    else this.resyncBreakpoints();
    this.needsRestart = false;
  }

  step(): RunResult {
    if (!this.built) return this.emptyResult('error', 'No program built yet');
    if (this.needsRestart) return this.emptyResult('restart-needed', 'Restart needed');
    const ip = this.cpu.ip;
    if (ip >= this.parsed.instrs.length) return this.emptyResult('end', 'At end of program');
    const before = this.snapshotRegs();
    this.cpu.intOutput = () => {};
    this.ex.step();
    const after = this.snapshotRegs();
    const regDiff = diffRegs(before, after);
    const instr = this.parsed.instrs[ip];
    const cellId = instr ? this.lineOwner[instr.lineNum - 1] ?? null : null;
    const expectResults = cellId ? this.evalExpects(cellId) : [];
    return {
      reason: this.cpu.halted ? 'halted' : 'cell-end', steps: 1, output: '', regDiff,
      halted: !!this.cpu.halted, expectResults, allPassed: expectResults.every(r => r.passed)
    };
  }

  continueRun(): RunResult {
    if (!this.built) return this.emptyResult('error', 'No program built yet');
    if (this.needsRestart) return this.emptyResult('restart-needed', 'Restart needed');
    const before = this.snapshotRegs();
    const outBuf: string[] = [];
    this.cpu.intOutput = (s: string) => outBuf.push(s);
    let steps = 0;
    const CAP = 200000;
    let reason: RunResult['reason'] = 'end';
    while (steps < CAP) {
      const ip = this.cpu.ip;
      if (ip >= this.parsed.instrs.length) { reason = 'end'; break; }
      if (this.breakpoints.has(ip)) { reason = 'breakpoint'; break; }
      this.ex.step();
      steps++;
      if (this.cpu.halted) { reason = 'halted'; break; }
    }
    if (steps >= CAP) reason = 'cap';
    const after = this.snapshotRegs();
    const regDiff = diffRegs(before, after);
    const ip = Math.min(this.cpu.ip, this.parsed.instrs.length - 1);
    const cellId = this.parsed.instrs[ip] ? this.lineOwner[this.parsed.instrs[ip].lineNum - 1] ?? null : null;
    const expectResults = cellId ? this.evalExpects(cellId) : [];
    return {
      reason, steps, output: outBuf.join(''), regDiff, halted: !!this.cpu.halted,
      expectResults, allPassed: expectResults.every(r => r.passed)
    };
  }

  private emptyResult(reason: RunResult['reason'], error: string): RunResult {
    return { reason, error, steps: 0, output: '', regDiff: {}, halted: false, expectResults: [], allPassed: true };
  }

  private snapshotRegs(): Record<string, number> {
    const r: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const k of [...REG_LIST, 'CS', 'DS', 'ES', 'SS']) r[k] = this.cpu.getReg(k);
    r['IP'] = this.cpu.ip;
    return r;
  }

  private evalCtx(): EvalContext {
    const cpu = this.cpu;
    const memRead = (addr: number, bits: number) => cpu.memRead(addr, bits);
    return {
      getReg: (n: string) => { try { return cpu.getReg(n.toUpperCase()); } catch { return null; } },
      getFlag: (n: string) => { const f = cpu.flags[n.toUpperCase()]; return typeof f === 'number' ? f & 1 : null; },
      memReadByte: (linear: number) => memRead(linear & 0xfffff, 8),
      getScreenChar: (row: number, col: number) => { const off = (row * 80 + col) * 2; return memRead(0xB8000 + off, 8); }
    };
  }

  evalExpects(cellId: string): ExpectResult[] {
    const clauses = this.expectsByCell.get(cellId) || [];
    if (clauses.length === 0) return [];
    return evaluateExpects(this.evalCtx(), clauses);
  }

  getFriendlyErrors(): FriendlyError[] {
    return friendlyErrors(this.getParseErrors());
  }

  toggleBreakpoint(cellId: string, lineInCell: number): boolean {
    const key = `${cellId}:${lineInCell}`;
    if (this.bpSource.has(key)) { this.bpSource.delete(key); this.resyncBreakpoints(); return false; }
    this.bpSource.add(key); this.resyncBreakpoints(); return true;
  }

  private resyncBreakpoints() {
    this.breakpoints.clear();
    for (const key of this.bpSource) {
      const [cid, ln] = key.split(':');
      const ci = this.cells.findIndex(c => c.id === cid);
      if (ci < 0) continue;
      const abs = this.starts[ci] + Number(ln) - 1;
      const idx = this.parsed.instrs.findIndex((ins: any) => ins.lineNum === abs);
      if (idx >= 0) this.breakpoints.add(idx);
    }
  }

  getBreakpointLines(cellId: string): Set<number> {
    const s = new Set<number>();
    for (const key of this.bpSource) { const [cid, ln] = key.split(':'); if (cid === cellId) s.add(Number(ln)); }
    return s;
  }

  getState(): LiveState {
    const ip = this.built ? this.cpu.ip : 0;
    const ins = this.built ? this.parsed.instrs[ip] : null;
    const line = ins ? ins.lineNum : null;
    const cellId = line ? this.lineOwner[line - 1] ?? null : null;
    return {
      regs: this.snapshotRegs(), flags: { ...this.cpu.flags },
      cursor: this.built ? { cellId, line, instrIndex: ip } : null,
      halted: !!this.cpu.halted, needsRestart: this.needsRestart,
      totalInstrs: this.built ? this.parsed.instrs.length : 0
    };
  }

  getOutput(cellId: string): CellOutput | undefined { return this.outputs.get(cellId); }
  getAllOutputs(): Map<string, CellOutput> { return new Map(this.outputs); }

  cellLineOffset(cellId: string): number | null {
    const ci = this.cells.findIndex(c => c.id === cellId);
    if (ci < 0) return null;
    return this.starts[ci];
  }

  getParseErrors(): { cellId: string | null; line: number | null; message: string }[] {
    return (this.parsed?.errors || []).map((e: any) => ({
      cellId: e.lineNum ? this.lineOwner[e.lineNum - 1] ?? null : null,
      line: e.lineNum ?? null,
      message: e.message
    }));
  }

  memHex(linear: number, rows = 8): { addr: number; bytes: number[] }[] {
    const out: { addr: number; bytes: number[] }[] = [];
    for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
      const addr = linear + r * 16;
      const bytes: number[] = [];
      for (let b = 0; b < 16; b++) bytes.push(this.cpu.memRead(addr + b, 8));
      out.push({ addr, bytes });
    }
    return out;
  }

  stackView(depth = 8): { sp: number; words: number[] } {
    const sp = this.cpu.getReg('SP');
    const linear = ((this.cpu.getReg('SS') << 4) + sp) & 0xFFFFF;
    const words: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < depth; i++) words.push(this.cpu.memRead(linear + i * 2, 16));
    return { sp, words };
  }

  screenText(): { ch: string; attr: number }[][] {
    const rows: { ch: string; attr: number }[][] = [];
    for (let r = 0; r < 25; r++) {
      const row: { ch: string; attr: number }[] = [];
      for (let c = 0; c < 80; c++) {
        const off = (r * 80 + c) * 2;
        const chCode = this.cpu.memRead(0xB8000 + off, 8);
        const attr = this.cpu.memRead(0xB8000 + off + 1, 8);
        row.push({ ch: String.fromCharCode(chCode), attr });
      }
      rows.push(row);
    }
    return rows;
  }
}

export class LiveSession {
  constructor() {
    this.cells = [];
    this.cpu = new CPU();
    this.ex = new Executor();
    this.outputs = new Map();
    this.needsRestart = false;
    this.built = false;
    this.parsed = null;
    this.starts = [];
    this.lineOwner = [];
    this.bpSource = new Set();
    this.breakpoints = new Set();
    this.expectsByCell = new Map();
    this.cellBase = 0x100;
  }

  setCells(cells) {
    const r = this.rebuild(cells);
    this.needsRestart = r.needsRestart;
    return r;
  }

  rebuild(cells) {
    this.cells = cells;
    this.outputs.clear();
    this.expectsByCell.clear();
    const codeCells = cells.filter(c => c.kind === 'code');
    const parts = [];
    this.starts = [];
    this.lineOwner = [];
    for (const c of codeCells) {
      this.starts.push(parts.length + 1);
      for (const ln of c.source.split('\\n')) { this.lineOwner.push(c.id); parts.push(ln); }
    }
    this.parsed = new Parser().parse(parts.join('\\n'));
    for (const c of codeCells) {
      this.expectsByCell.set(c.id, parseExpects(c.source));
    }
    this.built = true;
    const prevIP = this.cpu.ip;
    this.ex = new Executor();
    this.ex.load(this.parsed.instrs, { base: this.cellBase });
    this.cpu = new CPU();
    this.cpu.setMem(0, 0, 8);
    this.ex.bind(this.cpu);
    this.resyncBreakpoints();
    if (prevIP < this.parsed.instrs.length && this.parsed.instrs[prevIP]) {
      this.cpu.ip = prevIP;
      return { needsRestart: false };
    }
    return { needsRestart: true };
  }

  runCell(cellId) { return this.run(cellId); }

  runUpTo(cellId) {
    this.resetMachine(false);
    return this.run(cellId);
  }

  run(targetCellId) {
    if (!this.built) return this.emptyResult('error', 'No program built yet');
    if (this.needsRestart) return this.emptyResult('restart-needed', 'The machine needs a restart');
    const targetIdx = this.cells.findIndex(c => c.id === targetCellId && c.kind === 'code');
    if (targetIdx < 0) return this.emptyResult('error', 'No such code cell');
    const before = this.snapshotRegs();
    const outBuf = [];
    this.cpu.intOutput = (s) => outBuf.push(s);
    const cellEndLine = targetIdx + 1 < this.starts.length ? this.starts[targetIdx + 1] - 1 : Infinity;
    let steps = 0;
    const CAP = 200000;
    let reason = 'cell-end';
    while (steps < CAP) {
      const ip = this.cpu.ip;
      if (ip >= this.parsed.instrs.length) { reason = 'end'; break; }
      const curLine = this.parsed.instrs[ip].lineNum;
      if (curLine > cellEndLine) { reason = 'left-cell'; break; }
      if (this.breakpoints.has(ip)) { reason = 'breakpoint'; break; }
      this.ex.step();
      steps++;
      if (this.cpu.halted) { reason = 'halted'; break; }
    }
    if (steps >= CAP) reason = 'cap';
    const after = this.snapshotRegs();
    const regDiff = diffRegs(before, after);
    const output = outBuf.join('');
    const expectResults = this.evalExpects(targetCellId);
    const result = { reason, steps, output, regDiff, halted: !!this.cpu.halted, expectResults, allPassed: expectResults.every(r => r.passed) };
    this.outputs.set(targetCellId, { text: output, regDiff, steps, reason, stale: false, expectResults, allPassed: result.allPassed });
    return result;
  }

  resetMachine(clearBps = true) {
    this.cpu = new CPU();
    this.cpu.setMem(0, 0, 8);
    this.ex = new Executor();
    if (this.parsed) { this.ex.load(this.parsed.instrs, { base: this.cellBase }); this.ex.bind(this.cpu); }
    if (clearBps) { this.bpSource.clear(); this.breakpoints.clear(); }
    else this.resyncBreakpoints();
    this.needsRestart = false;
  }

  step() {
    if (!this.built) return this.emptyResult('error', 'No program built yet');
    if (this.needsRestart) return this.emptyResult('restart-needed', 'Restart needed');
    const ip = this.cpu.ip;
    if (ip >= this.parsed.instrs.length) return this.emptyResult('end', 'At end of program');
    const before = this.snapshotRegs();
    this.cpu.intOutput = () => {};
    this.ex.step();
    const after = this.snapshotRegs();
    const regDiff = diffRegs(before, after);
    const instr = this.parsed.instrs[ip];
    const cellId = instr ? this.lineOwner[instr.lineNum - 1] ?? null : null;
    const expectResults = cellId ? this.evalExpects(cellId) : [];
    return { reason: this.cpu.halted ? 'halted' : 'cell-end', steps: 1, output: '', regDiff, halted: !!this.cpu.halted, expectResults, allPassed: expectResults.every(r => r.passed) };
  }

  continueRun() {
    if (!this.built) return this.emptyResult('error', 'No program built yet');
    if (this.needsRestart) return this.emptyResult('restart-needed', 'Restart needed');
    const before = this.snapshotRegs();
    const outBuf = [];
    this.cpu.intOutput = (s) => outBuf.push(s);
    let steps = 0;
    const CAP = 200000;
    let reason = 'end';
    while (steps < CAP) {
      const ip = this.cpu.ip;
      if (ip >= this.parsed.instrs.length) { reason = 'end'; break; }
      if (this.breakpoints.has(ip)) { reason = 'breakpoint'; break; }
      this.ex.step();
      steps++;
      if (this.cpu.halted) { reason = 'halted'; break; }
    }
    if (steps >= CAP) reason = 'cap';
    const after = this.snapshotRegs();
    const regDiff = diffRegs(before, after);
    const ip = Math.min(this.cpu.ip, this.parsed.instrs.length - 1);
    const cellId = this.parsed.instrs[ip] ? this.lineOwner[this.parsed.instrs[ip].lineNum - 1] ?? null : null;
    const expectResults = cellId ? this.evalExpects(cellId) : [];
    return { reason, steps, output: outBuf.join(''), regDiff, halted: !!this.cpu.halted, expectResults, allPassed: expectResults.every(r => r.passed) };
  }

  emptyResult(reason, error) {
    return { reason, error, steps: 0, output: '', regDiff: {}, halted: false, expectResults: [], allPassed: true };
  }

  snapshotRegs() {
    const r = {};
    for (const k of [...REG_LIST, 'CS', 'DS', 'ES', 'SS']) r[k] = this.cpu.getReg(k);
    r['IP'] = this.cpu.ip;
    return r;
  }

  evalCtx() {
    const cpu = this.cpu;
    const memRead = (addr, bits) => cpu.memRead(addr, bits);
    return {
      getReg: (n) => { try { return cpu.getReg(n.toUpperCase()); } catch { return null; } },
      getFlag: (n) => { const f = cpu.flags[n.toUpperCase()]; return typeof f === 'number' ? f & 1 : null; },
      memReadByte: (linear) => memRead(linear & 0xfffff, 8),
      getScreenChar: (row, col) => { const off = (row * 80 + col) * 2; return memRead(0xB8000 + off, 8); }
    };
  }

  evalExpects(cellId) {
    const clauses = this.expectsByCell.get(cellId) || [];
    if (clauses.length === 0) return [];
    return evaluateExpects(this.evalCtx(), clauses);
  }

  getFriendlyErrors() {
    return friendlyErrors(this.getParseErrors());
  }

  toggleBreakpoint(cellId, lineInCell) {
    const key = cellId + ':' + lineInCell;
    if (this.bpSource.has(key)) { this.bpSource.delete(key); this.resyncBreakpoints(); return false; }
    this.bpSource.add(key); this.resyncBreakpoints(); return true;
  }

  resyncBreakpoints() {
    this.breakpoints.clear();
    for (const key of this.bpSource) {
      const [cid, ln] = key.split(':');
      const ci = this.cells.findIndex(c => c.id === cid);
      if (ci < 0) continue;
      const abs = this.starts[ci] + Number(ln) - 1;
      const idx = this.parsed.instrs.findIndex(ins => ins.lineNum === abs);
      if (idx >= 0) this.breakpoints.add(idx);
    }
  }

  getBreakpointLines(cellId) {
    const s = new Set();
    for (const key of this.bpSource) { const [cid, ln] = key.split(':'); if (cid === cellId) s.add(Number(ln)); }
    return s;
  }

  getState() {
    const ip = this.built ? this.cpu.ip : 0;
    const ins = this.built ? this.parsed.instrs[ip] : null;
    const line = ins ? ins.lineNum : null;
    const cellId = line ? this.lineOwner[line - 1] ?? null : null;
    return { regs: this.snapshotRegs(), flags: { ...this.cpu.flags }, cursor: this.built ? { cellId, line, instrIndex: ip } : null, halted: !!this.cpu.halted, needsRestart: this.needsRestart, totalInstrs: this.built ? this.parsed.instrs.length : 0 };
  }

  getOutput(cellId) { return this.outputs.get(cellId); }
  getAllOutputs() { return new Map(this.outputs); }
  cellLineOffset(cellId) { const ci = this.cells.findIndex(c => c.id === cellId); return ci < 0 ? null : this.starts[ci]; }

  getParseErrors() {
    return (this.parsed?.errors || []).map(e => ({
      cellId: e.lineNum ? this.lineOwner[e.lineNum - 1] ?? null : null,
      line: e.lineNum ?? null,
      message: e.message
    }));
  }

  memHex(linear, rows = 8) {
    const out = [];
    for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
      const addr = linear + r * 16;
      const bytes = [];
      for (let b = 0; b < 16; b++) bytes.push(this.cpu.memRead(addr + b, 8));
      out.push({ addr, bytes });
    }
    return out;
  }

  stackView(depth = 8) {
    const sp = this.cpu.getReg('SP');
    const linear = ((this.cpu.getReg('SS') << 4) + sp) & 0xFFFFF;
    const words = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < depth; i++) words.push(this.cpu.memRead(linear + i * 2, 16));
    return { sp, words };
  }

  screenText() {
    const rows = [];
    for (let r = 0; r < 25; r++) {
      const row = [];
      for (let c = 0; c < 80; c++) {
        const off = (r * 80 + c) * 2;
        const chCode = this.cpu.memRead(0xB8000 + off, 8);
        const attr = this.cpu.memRead(0xB8000 + off + 1, 8);
        row.push({ ch: String.fromCharCode(chCode), attr });
      }
      rows.push(row);
    }
    return rows;
  }
}

$content = @'
// ================================================================
//  LiveSession - the notebook's "one live machine" (R1 + R2)
//
//  Implements docs/NOTEBOOK_SEMANTICS.md:
//   - one machine per notebook, state persists across cell runs
//   - cells are source regions of ONE assembled program
//   - run on a cell = bring the CPU to the cell start, execute through
//     the cell end, leave the machine live at the cursor
//   - edits re-assemble; the machine continues when provably safe,
//     otherwise it is visibly marked `restart-needed` (never silently
//     inconsistent)
//
//  R2 adds: @expect checkable assertions, friendly errors,
//  register/flag hover docs, lesson metadata.
//
//  DOM-free and Node-testable (tests/session.test.ts).
// ================================================================
import { CPU, Parser, Executor } from './engine.mjs';
import { parseExpects, evaluateExpects } from './expect.js';
import type { ExpectResult, EvalContext } from './expect.js';
import { friendlyErrors } from './errors.js';
import type { FriendlyError } from './errors.js';

export type CellKind = 'code' | 'markdown';

export interface Cell {
  id: string;
  kind: CellKind;
  source: string;
}

export interface RunResult {
  reason: 'cell-end' | 'halted' | 'breakpoint' | 'cap' | 'left-cell' | 'reached' | 'end' | 'restart-needed' | 'error';
  error?: string;
  steps: number;
  output: string;
  regDiff: Record<string, [number, number]>;
  halted: boolean;
  expectResults: ExpectResult[];
  allPassed: boolean;
}

export interface CellOutput {
  text: string;
  regDiff: Record<string, [number, number]>;
  steps: number;
  reason: RunResult['reason'];
  stale: boolean;
  expectResults: ExpectResult[];
  allPassed: boolean;
}

const REG_LIST = ['AX', 'BX', 'CX', 'DX', 'SI', 'DI', 'BP', 'SP'];

export interface LiveState {
  regs: Record<string, number>;
  flags: Record<string, number>;
  cursor: { cellId: string | null; line: number | null; instrIndex: number } | null;
  halted: boolean;
  needsRestart: boolean;
  totalInstrs: number;
}

export class LiveSession {
  private cells: Cell[] = [];
  private cpu = new CPU();
  private ex = new Executor();
  private outputs = new Map<string, CellOutput>();
  private needsRestart = false;
  private built = false;
  private parsed: any = null;
  private starts: number[] = [];
  private lineOwner: string[] = [];
  private bpSource = new Set<string>();
  private breakpoints = new Set<number>();
  private expectsByCell = new Map<string, ReturnType<typeof parseExpects>>();
  private cellBase: number = 0x100;

  setCells(cells: Cell[]): { needsRestart: boolean } {
    const r = this.rebuild(cells);
    this.needsRestart = r.needsRestart;
    return r;
  }

  private rebuild(cells: Cell[]): { needsRestart: boolean } {
    this.cells = cells;
    this.outputs.clear();
    this.expectsByCell.clear();
    const codeCells = cells.filter(c => c.kind === 'code');
    const parts: string[] = [];
    this.starts = [];
    this.lineOwner = [];
    for (const c of codeCells) {
      this.starts.push(parts.length + 1);
      const lines = c.source.split('\n');
      for (const ln of lines) { this.lineOwner.push(c.id); parts.push(ln); }
    }
    const concat = parts.join('\n');
    this.parsed = new Parser().parse(concat);
    for (const c of codeCells) {
      this.expectsByCell.set(c.id, parseExpects(c.source));
    }
    this.built = true;
    const prevIP = this.cpu.ip;
    this.ex = new Executor();
    this.ex.load(this.parsed.instrs, { base: this.cellBase });
    this.cpu = new CPU();
    this.cpu.setMem(0, 0, 8);
    this.ex.bind(this.cpu);
    this.resyncBreakpoints();
    if (prevIP < this.parsed.instrs.length && this.parsed.instrs[prevIP]) {
      this.cpu.ip = prevIP;
      return { needsRestart: false };
    }
    return { needsRestart: true };
  }

  get cellCount(): number { return this.cells.length; }
  get instrCount(): number { return this.parsed?.instrs?.length ?? 0; }

  runCell(cellId: string): RunResult {
    return this.run(cellId, 'cell-end');
  }

  runUpTo(cellId: string): RunResult {
    this.resetMachine(false);
    return this.run(cellId, 'cell-end');
  }

  private run(targetCellId: string, mode: 'cell-end'): RunResult {
    if (!this.built) return this.emptyResult('error', 'No program built yet');
    if (this.needsRestart) return this.emptyResult('restart-needed', 'The machine needs a restart because a cell above was edited');
    const targetIdx = this.cells.findIndex(c => c.id === targetCellId && c.kind === 'code');
    if (targetIdx < 0) return this.emptyResult('error', 'No such code cell');
    const before = this.snapshotRegs();
    const outBuf: string[] = [];
    this.cpu.intOutput = (s: string) => outBuf.push(s);
    const startIP = this.cpu.ip;
    const cellStartLine = this.starts[targetIdx];
    const cellEndLine = targetIdx + 1 < this.starts.length ? this.starts[targetIdx + 1] - 1 : Infinity;
    let steps = 0;
    const CAP = 200000;
    let reason: RunResult['reason'] = 'cell-end';
    while (steps < CAP) {
      const ip = this.cpu.ip;
      if (ip >= this.parsed.instrs.length) { reason = 'end'; break; }
      const ins = this.parsed.instrs[ip];
      const curLine = ins.lineNum;
      if (curLine > cellEndLine) { reason = 'left-cell'; break; }
      if (this.breakpoints.has(ip)) { reason = 'breakpoint'; break; }
      this.ex.step();
      steps++;
      if (this.cpu.halted) { reason = 'halted'; break; }
    }
    if (steps >= CAP) reason = 'cap';
    const after = this.snapshotRegs();
    const regDiff = diffRegs(before, after);
    const output = outBuf.join('');
    const expectResults = this.evalExpects(targetCellId);
    const result: RunResult = {
      reason, steps, output, regDiff, halted: !!this.cpu.halted,
      expectResults, allPassed: expectResults.every(r => r.passed)
    };
    this.outputs.set(targetCellId, {
      text: output, regDiff, steps, reason, stale: false, expectResults, allPassed: result.allPassed
    });
    return result;
  }

  private resetMachine(clearBps = true) {
    this.cpu = new CPU();
    this.cpu.setMem(0, 0, 8);
    this.ex = new Executor();
    if (this.parsed) {
      this.ex.load(this.parsed.instrs, { base: this.cellBase });
      this.ex.bind(this.cpu);
    }
    if (clearBps) { this.bpSource.clear(); this.breakpoints.clear(); }
    else this.resyncBreakpoints();
    this.needsRestart = false;
  }

  step(): RunResult {
    if (!this.built) return this.emptyResult('error', 'No program built yet');
    if (this.needsRestart) return this.emptyResult('restart-needed', 'Restart needed');
    const ip = this.cpu.ip;
    if (ip >= this.parsed.instrs.length) return this.emptyResult('end', 'At end of program');
    const before = this.snapshotRegs();
    this.cpu.intOutput = (s: string) => {};
    this.ex.step();
    const after = this.snapshotRegs();
    const regDiff = diffRegs(before, after);
    const cellId = this.lineOwner[this.parsed.instrs[ip]?.lineNum - 1] ?? null;
    const expectResults = cellId ? this.evalExpects(cellId) : [];
    return { reason: this.cpu.halted ? 'halted' : 'cell-end', steps: 1, output: '', regDiff, halted: !!this.cpu.halted, expectResults, allPassed: expectResults.every(r => r.passed) };
  }

  continueRun(): RunResult {
    if (!this.built) return this.emptyResult('error', 'No program built yet');
    if (this.needsRestart) return this.emptyResult('restart-needed', 'Restart needed');
    const before = this.snapshotRegs();
    const outBuf: string[] = [];
    this.cpu.intOutput = (s: string) => outBuf.push(s);
    let steps = 0;
    const CAP = 200000;
    let reason: RunResult['reason'] = 'end';
    while (steps < CAP) {
      const ip = this.cpu.ip;
      if (ip >= this.parsed.instrs.length) { reason = 'end'; break; }
      if (this.breakpoints.has(ip)) { reason = 'breakpoint'; break; }
      this.ex.step();
      steps++;
      if (this.cpu.halted) { reason = 'halted'; break; }
    }
    if (steps >= CAP) reason = 'cap';
    const after = this.snapshotRegs();
    const regDiff = diffRegs(before, after);
    const ip = Math.min(this.cpu.ip, this.parsed.instrs.length - 1);
    const cellId = this.parsed.instrs[ip] ? this.lineOwner[this.parsed.instrs[ip].lineNum - 1] ?? null : null;
    const expectResults = cellId ? this.evalExpects(cellId) : [];
    return { reason, steps, output: outBuf.join(''), regDiff, halted: !!this.cpu.halted, expectResults, allPassed: expectResults.every(r => r.passed) };
  }

  private emptyResult(reason: RunResult['reason'], error: string): RunResult {
    return { reason, error, steps: 0, output: '', regDiff: {}, halted: false, expectResults: [], allPassed: true };
  }

  private snapshotRegs(): Record<string, number> {
    const r: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const k of [...REG_LIST, 'CS', 'DS', 'ES', 'SS']) r[k] = this.cpu.getReg(k);
    r['IP'] = this.cpu.ip;
    return r;
  }

  private evalCtx(): EvalContext {
    const cpu = this.cpu;
    const memRead = (addr: number, bits: number) => cpu.memRead(addr, bits);
    return {
      getReg: (n: string) => { try { return cpu.getReg(n.toUpperCase()); } catch { return null; } },
      getFlag: (n: string) => { const f = cpu.flags[n.toUpperCase()]; return typeof f === 'number' ? f & 1 : null; },
      memReadByte: (linear: number) => memRead(linear & 0xfffff, 8),
      getScreenChar: (row: number, col: number) => { const off = (row * 80 + col) * 2; return memRead(0xB8000 + off, 8); }
    };
  }

  evalExpects(cellId: string): ExpectResult[] {
    const clauses = this.expectsByCell.get(cellId) || [];
    if (clauses.length === 0) return [];
    return evaluateExpects(this.evalCtx(), clauses);
  }

  getFriendlyErrors(): FriendlyError[] {
    return friendlyErrors(this.getParseErrors());
  }

  toggleBreakpoint(cellId: string, lineInCell: number): boolean {
    const key = `${cellId}:${lineInCell}`;
    if (this.bpSource.has(key)) { this.bpSource.delete(key); this.resyncBreakpoints(); return false; }
    this.bpSource.add(key); this.resyncBreakpoints(); return true;
  }

  private resyncBreakpoints() {
    this.breakpoints.clear();
    for (const key of this.bpSource) {
      const [cid, ln] = key.split(':');
      const ci = this.cells.findIndex(c => c.id === cid);
      if (ci < 0) continue;
      const abs = this.starts[ci] + Number(ln) - 1;
      const idx = this.parsed.instrs.findIndex((ins: any) => ins.lineNum === abs);
      if (idx >= 0) this.breakpoints.add(idx);
    }
  }

  getBreakpointLines(cellId: string): Set<number> {
    const s = new Set<number>();
    for (const key of this.bpSource) { const [cid, ln] = key.split(':'); if (cid === cellId) s.add(Number(ln)); }
    return s;
  }

  getState(): LiveState {
    const ip = this.built ? this.cpu.ip : 0;
    const ins = this.built ? this.parsed.instrs[ip] : null;
    const line = ins ? ins.lineNum : null;
    const cellId = line ? this.lineOwner[line - 1] ?? null : null;
    return {
      regs: this.snapshotRegs(), flags: { ...this.cpu.flags },
      cursor: this.built ? { cellId, line, instrIndex: ip } : null,
      halted: !!this.cpu.halted, needsRestart: this.needsRestart,
      totalInstrs: this.built ? this.parsed.instrs.length : 0
    };
  }

  getOutput(cellId: string): CellOutput | undefined { return this.outputs.get(cellId); }
  getAllOutputs(): Map<string, CellOutput> { return new Map(this.outputs); }

  cellLineOffset(cellId: string): number | null {
    const ci = this.cells.findIndex(c => c.id === cellId);
    if (ci < 0) return null;
    return this.starts[ci];
  }

  getParseErrors(): { cellId: string | null; line: number | null; message: string }[] {
    return (this.parsed?.errors || []).map((e: any) => ({
      cellId: e.lineNum ? this.lineOwner[e.lineNum - 1] ?? null : null,
      line: e.lineNum ?? null,
      message: e.message
    }));
  }

  memHex(linear: number, rows = 8): { addr: number; bytes: number[] }[] {
    const out: { addr: number; bytes: number[] }[] = [];
    for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
      const addr = linear + r * 16;
      const bytes: number[] = [];
      for (let b = 0; b < 16; b++) bytes.push(this.cpu.memRead(addr + b, 8));
      out.push({ addr, bytes });
    }
    return out;
  }

  stackView(depth = 8): { sp: number; words: number[] } {
    const sp = this.cpu.getReg('SP');
    const linear = ((this.cpu.getReg('SS') << 4) + sp) & 0xFFFFF;
    const words: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < depth; i++) words.push(this.cpu.memRead(linear + i * 2, 16));
    return { sp, words };
  }

  screenText(): { ch: string; attr: number }[][] {
    const rows: { ch: string; attr: number }[][] = [];
    for (let r = 0; r < 25; r++) {
      const row: { ch: string; attr: number }[] = [];
      for (let c = 0; c < 80; c++) {
        const off = (r * 80 + c) * 2;
        const chCode = this.cpu.memRead(0xB8000 + off, 8);
        const attr = this.cpu.memRead(0xB8000 + off + 1, 8);
        row.push({ ch: String.fromCharCode(chCode), attr });
      }
      rows.push(row);
    }
    return rows;
  }
}

function diffRegs(before: Record<string, number>, after: Record<string, number>): Record<string, [number, number]> {
  const d: Record<string, [number, number]> = {};
  for (const k of Object.keys(after)) {
    if ((before[k] ?? 0) !== (after[k] ?? 0)) d[k] = [before[k] ?? 0, after[k] ?? 0];
  }
  return d;
}

import { CPU, Parser, Executor } from './engine.mjs';
import { parseExpects, evaluateExpects } from './expect.js';
import type { ExpectResult, EvalContext } from './expect.js';
import { friendlyErrors } from './errors.js';
import type { FriendlyError } from './errors.js';

  id: string;
  kind: CellKind;
  source: string;
}

export class LiveSession {
  private cells: Cell[] = [];
  private cpu = new CPU();
  private ex = new Executor();
  private outputs = new Map<string, CellOutput>();
  private needsRestart = false;
  private built = false;
  private parsed: any = null;
  private starts: number[] = [];
  private lineOwner: string[] = [];
  private bpSource = new Set<string>();
  private breakpoints = new Set<number>();
  private expectsByCell = new Map<string, ReturnType<typeof parseExpects>>();
  private cellBase: number = 0x100;

  setCells(cells: Cell[]): { needsRestart: boolean } {
    const r = this.rebuild(cells);
    this.needsRestart = r.needsRestart;
    return r;
  }

  private rebuild(cells: Cell[]): { needsRestart: boolean } {
    this.cells = cells;
    this.outputs.clear();
    this.expectsByCell.clear();
    const codeCells = cells.filter(c => c.kind === 'code');
    const parts: string[] = [];
    this.starts = [];
    this.lineOwner = [];
    for (const c of codeCells) {
      this.starts.push(parts.length + 1);
      const lines = c.source.split('\\n');
      for (const ln of lines) { this.lineOwner.push(c.id); parts.push(ln); }
    }
    const concat = parts.join('\\n');
    this.parsed = new Parser().parse(concat);
    for (const c of codeCells) {
      this.expectsByCell.set(c.id, parseExpects(c.source));
    }
    this.built = true;
    const prevIP = this.cpu.ip;
    this.ex = new Executor();
    this.ex.load(this.parsed.instrs, { base: this.cellBase });
    this.cpu = new CPU();
    this.cpu.setMem(0, 0, 8);
    this.ex.bind(this.cpu);
    this.resyncBreakpoints();
    if (prevIP < this.parsed.instrs.length && this.parsed.instrs[prevIP]) {
      this.cpu.ip = prevIP;
      return { needsRestart: false };
    }
    return { needsRestart: true };
  }

  get cellCount(): number { return this.cells.length; }
  get instrCount(): number { return this.parsed?.instrs?.length ?? 0; }

  runCell(cellId: string): RunResult { return this.run(cellId, 'cell-end'); }

  runUpTo(cellId: string): RunResult {
    this.resetMachine(false);
    return this.run(cellId, 'cell-end');
  }

  private run(targetCellId: string, _mode: 'cell-end'): RunResult {
    if (!this.built) return this.emptyResult('error', 'No program built yet');
    if (this.needsRestart) return this.emptyResult('restart-needed', 'Restart needed');
    const targetIdx = this.cells.findIndex(c => c.id === targetCellId && c.kind === 'code');
    if (targetIdx < 0) return this.emptyResult('error', 'No such code cell');
    const before = this.snapshotRegs();
    const outBuf: string[] = [];
    this.cpu.intOutput = (s: string) => outBuf.push(s);
    const cellEndLine = targetIdx + 1 < this.starts.length ? this.starts[targetIdx + 1] - 1 : Infinity;
    let steps = 0;
    const CAP = 200000;
    let reason: RunResult['reason'] = 'cell-end';
    while (steps < CAP) {
      const ip = this.cpu.ip;
      if (ip >= this.parsed.instrs.length) { reason = 'end'; break; }
      const ins = this.parsed.instrs[ip];
      if (ins.lineNum > cellEndLine) { reason = 'left-cell'; break; }
      if (this.breakpoints.has(ip)) { reason = 'breakpoint'; break; }
      this.ex.step();
      steps++;
      if (this.cpu.halted) { reason = 'halted'; break; }
    }
    if (steps >= CAP) reason = 'cap';
    const after = this.snapshotRegs();
    const regDiff = diffRegs(before, after);
    const expectResults = this.evalExpects(targetCellId);
    const result: RunResult = { reason, steps, output: outBuf.join(''), regDiff, halted: !!this.cpu.halted, expectResults, allPassed: expectResults.every(r => r.passed) };
    this.outputs.set(targetCellId, { text: outBuf.join(''), regDiff, steps, reason, stale: false, expectResults, allPassed: result.allPassed });
    return result;
  }

  private resetMachine(clearBps = true) {
    this.cpu = new CPU();
    this.cpu.setMem(0, 0, 8);
    this.ex = new Executor();
    if (this.parsed) { this.ex.load(this.parsed.instrs, { base: this.cellBase }); this.ex.bind(this.cpu); }
    if (clearBps) { this.bpSource.clear(); this.breakpoints.clear(); } else this.resyncBreakpoints();
    this.needsRestart = false;
  }

  step(): RunResult {
    if (!this.built) return this.emptyResult('error', 'No program built yet');
    if (this.needsRestart) return this.emptyResult('restart-needed', 'Restart needed');
    const ip = this.cpu.ip;
    if (ip >= this.parsed.instrs.length) return this.emptyResult('end', 'At end of program');
    const before = this.snapshotRegs();
    this.cpu.intOutput = () => {};
    this.ex.step();
    const after = this.snapshotRegs();
    const regDiff = diffRegs(before, after);
    const cellId = this.lineOwner[this.parsed.instrs[ip]?.lineNum - 1] ?? null;
    const expectResults = cellId ? this.evalExpects(cellId) : [];
    return { reason: this.cpu.halted ? 'halted' : 'cell-end', steps: 1, output: '', regDiff, halted: !!this.cpu.halted, expectResults, allPassed: expectResults.every(r => r.passed) };
  }

  continueRun(): RunResult {
    if (!this.built) return this.emptyResult('error', 'No program built yet');
    if (this.needsRestart) return this.emptyResult('restart-needed', 'Restart needed');
    const before = this.snapshotRegs();
    const outBuf: string[] = [];
    this.cpu.intOutput = (s: string) => outBuf.push(s);
    let steps = 0;
    const CAP = 200000;
    let reason: RunResult['reason'] = 'end';
    while (steps < CAP) {
      const ip = this.cpu.ip;
      if (ip >= this.parsed.instrs.length) { reason = 'end'; break; }
      if (this.breakpoints.has(ip)) { reason = 'breakpoint'; break; }
      this.ex.step();
      steps++;
      if (this.cpu.halted) { reason = 'halted'; break; }
    }
    if (steps >= CAP) reason = 'cap';
    const after = this.snapshotRegs();
    const regDiff = diffRegs(before, after);
    const ip = Math.min(this.cpu.ip, this.parsed.instrs.length - 1);
    const cellId = this.parsed.instrs[ip] ? this.lineOwner[this.parsed.instrs[ip].lineNum - 1] ?? null : null;
    const expectResults = cellId ? this.evalExpects(cellId) : [];
    return { reason, steps, output: outBuf.join(''), regDiff, halted: !!this.cpu.halted, expectResults, allPassed: expectResults.every(r => r.passed) };
  }

  private emptyResult(reason: RunResult['reason'], error: string): RunResult {
    return { reason, error, steps: 0, output: '', regDiff: {}, halted: false, expectResults: [], allPassed: true };
  }

  private snapshotRegs(): Record<string, number> {
    const r: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const k of [...REG_LIST, 'CS', 'DS', 'ES', 'SS']) r[k] = this.cpu.getReg(k);
    r['IP'] = this.cpu.ip;
    return r;
  }

  private evalCtx(): EvalContext {
    const cpu = this.cpu;
    const memRead = (addr: number, bits: number) => cpu.memRead(addr, bits);
    return {
      getReg: (n: string) => { try { return cpu.getReg(n.toUpperCase()); } catch { return null; } },
      getFlag: (n: string) => { const f = cpu.flags[n.toUpperCase()]; return typeof f === 'number' ? f & 1 : null; },
      memReadByte: (linear: number) => memRead(linear & 0xfffff, 8),
      getScreenChar: (row: number, col: number) => { const off = (row * 80 + col) * 2; return memRead(0xB8000 + off, 8); }
    };
  }

  evalExpects(cellId: string): ExpectResult[] {
    const clauses = this.expectsByCell.get(cellId) || [];
    if (clauses.length === 0) return [];
    return evaluateExpects(this.evalCtx(), clauses);
  }

  getFriendlyErrors(): FriendlyError[] {
    return friendlyErrors(this.getParseErrors());
  }

  toggleBreakpoint(cellId: string, lineInCell: number): boolean {
    const key = \`\${cellId}:\${lineInCell}\`;
    if (this.bpSource.has(key)) { this.bpSource.delete(key); this.resyncBreakpoints(); return false; }
    this.bpSource.add(key); this.resyncBreakpoints(); return true;
  }

  private resyncBreakpoints() {
    this.breakpoints.clear();
    for (const key of this.bpSource) {
      const [cid, ln] = key.split(':');
      const ci = this.cells.findIndex(c => c.id === cid);
      if (ci < 0) continue;
      const abs = this.starts[ci] + Number(ln) - 1;
      const idx = this.parsed.instrs.findIndex((ins: any) => ins.lineNum === abs);
      if (idx >= 0) this.breakpoints.add(idx);
    }
  }

  getBreakpointLines(cellId: string): Set<number> {
    const s = new Set<number>();
    for (const key of this.bpSource) { const [cid, ln] = key.split(':'); if (cid === cellId) s.add(Number(ln)); }
    return s;
  }

  getState(): LiveState {
    const ip = this.built ? this.cpu.ip : 0;
    const ins = this.built ? this.parsed.instrs[ip] : null;
    const line = ins ? ins.lineNum : null;
    const cellId = line ? this.lineOwner[line - 1] ?? null : null;
    return { regs: this.snapshotRegs(), flags: { ...this.cpu.flags }, cursor: this.built ? { cellId, line, instrIndex: ip } : null, halted: !!this.cpu.halted, needsRestart: this.needsRestart, totalInstrs: this.built ? this.parsed.instrs.length : 0 };
  }

  getOutput(cellId: string): CellOutput | undefined { return this.outputs.get(cellId); }
  getAllOutputs(): Map<string, CellOutput> { return new Map(this.outputs); }
  cellLineOffset(cellId: string): number | null { const ci = this.cells.findIndex(c => c.id === cellId); return ci < 0 ? null : this.starts[ci]; }

  getParseErrors(): { cellId: string | null; line: number | null; message: string }[] {
    return (this.parsed?.errors || []).map((e: any) => ({ cellId: e.lineNum ? this.lineOwner[e.lineNum - 1] ?? null : null, line: e.lineNum ?? null, message: e.message }));
  }

  memHex(linear: number, rows = 8): { addr: number; bytes: number[] }[] {
    const out: { addr: number; bytes: number[] }[] = [];
    for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) { const addr = linear + r * 16; const bytes: number[] = []; for (let b = 0; b < 16; b++) bytes.push(this.cpu.memRead(addr + b, 8)); out.push({ addr, bytes }); }
    return out;
  }

  stackView(depth = 8): { sp: number; words: number[] } {
    const sp = this.cpu.getReg('SP');
    const linear = ((this.cpu.getReg('SS') << 4) + sp) & 0xFFFFF;
    const words: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < depth; i++) words.push(this.cpu.memRead(linear + i * 2, 16));
    return { sp, words };
  }

  screenText(): { ch: string; attr: number }[][] {
    const rows: { ch: string; attr: number }[][] = [];
    for (let r = 0; r < 25; r++) {
      const row: { ch: string; attr: number }[] = [];
      for (let c = 0; c < 80; c++) {
        const off = (r * 80 + c) * 2;
        const chCode = this.cpu.memRead(0xB8000 + off, 8);
        const attr = this.cpu.memRead(0xB8000 + off + 1, 8);
        row.push({ ch: String.fromCharCode(chCode), attr });
      }
      rows.push(row);
    }
    return rows;
  }
}

function diffRegs(before: Record<string, number>, after: Record<string, number>): Record<string, [number, number]> {
  const d: Record<string, [number, number]> = {};
  for (const k of Object.keys(after)) { if ((before[k] ?? 0) !== (after[k] ?? 0)) d[k] = [before[k] ?? 0, after[k] ?? 0]; }
  return d;
}

// ================================================================
//  LiveSession â€” the notebook's "one live machine" (R1 + R2)
//
//  Implements docs/NOTEBOOK_SEMANTICS.md:
//   - one machine per notebook, state persists across cell runs
//   - cells are source regions of ONE assembled program
//   - â–¶ on a cell = bring the CPU to the cell start, execute through
//     the cell end, leave the machine live at the cursor
//   - edits re-assemble; the machine continues when provably safe,
//     otherwise it is visibly marked `restart-needed` (never silently
//     inconsistent)
//
//  R2 adds: @expect checkable assertions, friendly errors,
//  register/flag hover docs, lesson metadata.
//
//  DOM-free and Node-testable (tests/session.test.ts).
// ================================================================
import { CPU, Parser, Executor } from './engine.mjs';
import { parseExpects, evaluateExpects, type ExpectResult, type EvalContext } from './expect.js';
import { friendlyErrors, type FriendlyError } from './errors.js';

export type CellKind = 'code' | 'markdown';

export interface Cell {
  id: string;
  kind: CellKind;
  source: string;
}

export interface RunResult {
  reason: 'cell-end' | 'halted' | 'breakpoint' | 'cap' | 'left-cell' | 'reached' | 'end' | 'restart-needed' | 'error';
  error?: string;
  steps: number;
  output: string;
  regDiff: Record<string, [number, number]>;
  halted: boolean;
  expectResults: ExpectResult[];
  allPassed: boolean;
}

export interface CellOutput {
  text: string;
  regDiff: Record<string, [number, number]>;
  steps: number;
  reason: RunResult['reason'];
  stale: boolean;
  expectResults: ExpectResult[];
  allPassed: boolean;
}

const REG_LIST = ['AX', 'BX', 'CX', 'DX', 'SI', 'DI', 'BP', 'SP'];

export interface LiveState {
  regs: Record<string, number>;
  flags: Record<string, number>;
  cursor: { cellId: string | null; line: number | null; instrIndex: number } | null;

function diffRegs(before: Record<string, number>, after: Record<string, number>): Record<string, [number, number]> {
  const d: Record<string, [number, number]> = {};
  for (const k of Object.keys(after)) {
    if ((before[k] ?? 0) !== (after[k] ?? 0)) d[k] = [before[k] ?? 0, after[k] ?? 0];
  }
  return d;
}

  private snapshotRegs(): Record<string, number> {
    const r: Record<string, number> = {};

  toggleBreakpoint(cellId: string, lineInCell: number): boolean {
    const key = `${cellId}:${lineInCell}`;
    if (this.bpSource.has(key)) { this.bpSource.delete(key); this.resyncBreakpoints(); return false; }
    this.bpSource.add(key); this.resyncBreakpoints(); return true;
  }

  private resyncBreakpoints() {
    this.breakpoints.clear();
    for (const key of this.bpSource) {
      const [cid, ln] = key.split(':');
      const ci = this.cells.findIndex(c => c.id === cid);
      if (ci < 0) continue;
      const abs = this.starts[ci] + Number(ln) - 1;
      const idx = this.parsed.instrs.findIndex((ins: any) => ins.lineNum === abs);
      if (idx >= 0) this.breakpoints.add(idx);
    }
  }

    return s;
  }

// ================================================================
//  LiveSession — the notebook's "one live machine" (R1 + R2)
//
//  Implements docs/NOTEBOOK_SEMANTICS.md:
//   - one machine per notebook, state persists across cell runs
//   - cells are source regions of ONE assembled program
//   - ▶ on a cell = bring the CPU to the cell start, execute through
//     the cell end, leave the machine live at the cursor
//   - edits re-assemble; the machine continues when provably safe,
//     otherwise it is visibly marked `restart-needed` (never silently
//     inconsistent)
//
//  R2 adds: @expect checkable assertions, friendly errors,
//  register/flag hover docs, lesson metadata.
//
//  DOM-free and Node-testable (tests/session.test.ts).
// ================================================================
import { CPU, Parser, Executor } from './engine.mjs';
import { parseExpects, evaluateExpects, type ExpectResult, type EvalContext } from './expect.js';
import { friendlyErrors, type FriendlyError } from './errors.js';

export type CellKind = 'code' | 'markdown';

export interface Cell {
  id: string;
  kind: CellKind;
  source: string;
}

export interface RunResult {
  reason: 'cell-end' | 'halted' | 'breakpoint' | 'cap' | 'left-cell' | 'reached' | 'end' | 'restart-needed' | 'error';
  error?: string;
  steps: number;
  output: string;
  regDiff: Record<string, [number, number]>;
  halted: boolean;
  expectResults: ExpectResult[];
  allPassed: boolean;
}

export interface CellOutput {
  text: string;
  regDiff: Record<string, [number, number]>;
  steps: number;
  reason: RunResult['reason'];
  stale: boolean;
  expectResults: ExpectResult[];
  allPassed: boolean;
}

const REG_LIST = ['AX', 'BX', 'CX', 'DX', 'SI', 'DI', 'BP', 'SP'];

export interface LiveState {
  regs: Record<string, number>;
  flags: Record<string, number>;
  cursor: { cellId: string | null; line: number | null; instrIndex: number } | null;
  halted: boolean;
  needsRestart: boolean;
  totalInstrs: number;
}

  private emptyResult(reason: RunResult['reason'], error: string): RunResult {
    return { reason, error, steps: 0, output: '', regDiff: {}, halted: false, expectResults: [], allPassed: true };
  }

  private snapshotRegs(): Record<string, number> {
    const r: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const k of [...REG_LIST, 'CS', 'DS', 'ES', 'SS']) r[k] = this.cpu.getReg(k);
    r['IP'] = this.cpu.ip;
    return r;
  toggleBreakpoint(cellId: string, lineInCell: number): boolean {
    const key = `${cellId}:${lineInCell}`;
    if (this.bpSource.has(key)) { this.bpSource.delete(key); this.resyncBreakpoints(); return false; }
    this.bpSource.add(key); this.resyncBreakpoints(); return true;
  }

>> // ================================================================
>> //  LiveSession — the notebook's "one live machine" (R1 + R2)
>> //
>> //  Implements docs/NOTEBOOK_SEMANTICS.md:
>> //   - one machine per notebook, state persists across cell runs
>> //   - cells are source regions of ONE assembled program
>> //   - ▶ on a cell = bring the CPU to the cell start, execute through
>> //     the cell end, leave the machine live at the cursor
>> //   - edits re-assemble; the machine continues when provably safe,
>> //     otherwise it is visibly marked `restart-needed` (never silently
>> //     inconsistent)
>> //
>> //  R2 adds: @expect checkable assertions, friendly errors,

>> //  DOM-free and Node-testable (tests/session.test.ts).

export class LiveSession {
  private cells: Cell[] = [];
  private cpu = new CPU();
  private ex = new Executor();
  private outputs = new Map<string, CellOutput>();
  private needsRestart = false;
  private built = false;
  private parsed: any = null;
  private starts: number[] = [];
  private lineOwner: string[] = [];
  private bpSource = new Set<string>();
  private breakpoints = new Set<number>();
  private expectsByCell = new Map<string, ReturnType<typeof parseExpects>>();
  private cellBase: number = 0x100;

  setCells(cells: Cell[]): { needsRestart: boolean } {
    const r = this.rebuild(cells);
    this.needsRestart = r.needsRestart;
    return r;
  }

  private rebuild(cells: Cell[]): { needsRestart: boolean } {
    this.cells = cells;
    this.outputs.clear();
    this.expectsByCell.clear();
    const codeCells = cells.filter(c => c.kind === 'code');
    const parts: string[] = [];
    this.starts = [];
    this.lineOwner = [];
    for (const c of codeCells) {
      this.starts.push(parts.length + 1);
      const lines = c.source.split('\n');
      for (const ln of lines) { this.lineOwner.push(c.id); parts.push(ln); }
    }
    const concat = parts.join('\n');
    this.parsed = new Parser().parse(concat);
    for (const c of codeCells) {
      this.expectsByCell.set(c.id, parseExpects(c.source));
    }
    this.built = true;
    const prevIP = this.cpu.ip;
    this.ex = new Executor();
    this.ex.load(this.parsed.instrs, { base: this.cellBase });
    this.cpu = new CPU();
    this.cpu.setMem(0, 0, 8);
    this.ex.bind(this.cpu);
    this.resyncBreakpoints();
    if (prevIP < this.parsed.instrs.length && this.parsed.instrs[prevIP]) {
      this.cpu.ip = prevIP;
      return { needsRestart: false };
    }
    return { needsRestart: true };
  }

  steps: number;

  private run(targetCellId: string, mode: 'cell-end'): RunResult {
    if (!this.built) return this.emptyResult('error', 'No program built yet');
    if (this.needsRestart) return this.emptyResult('restart-needed', 'The machine needs a restart because a cell above was edited');
    const targetIdx = this.cells.findIndex((c: Cell) => c.id === targetCellId && c.kind === 'code');

    const cellEndLine = targetIdx + 1 < this.starts.length ? this.starts[targetIdx + 1] - 1 : Infinity;
    let steps = 0; const CAP = 200000; let reason: RunResult['reason'] = 'cell-end';
    while (steps < CAP) {
      const ip = this.cpu.ip;
      if (ip >= this.parsed.instrs.length) { reason = 'end'; break; }
      const curLine = this.parsed.instrs[ip].lineNum;
      if (curLine > cellEndLine) { reason = 'left-cell'; break; }
      if (this.breakpoints.has(ip)) { reason = 'breakpoint'; break; }
      this.ex.step(); steps++;
      if (this.cpu.halted) { reason = 'halted'; break; }

    if (steps >= CAP) reason = 'cap';
    const after = this.snapshotRegs();
    const regDiff = diffRegs(before, after);
    const expectResults = this.evalExpects(targetCellId);
    const result: RunResult = { reason, steps, output: outBuf.join(''), regDiff, halted: !!this.cpu.halted, expectResults, allPassed: expectResults.every((r: ExpectResult) => r.passed) };
    this.outputs.set(targetCellId, { text: result.output, regDiff, steps, reason, stale: false, expectResults, allPassed: result.allPassed });
    return result;
  }

content = '''  private resetMachine(clearBps = true) {
    this.cpu = new CPU(); this.cpu.setMem(0, 0, 8);
    this.ex = new Executor();
    if (this.parsed) { this.ex.load(this.parsed.instrs, { base: this.cellBase }); this.ex.bind(this.cpu); }
    if (clearBps) { this.bpSource.clear(); this.breakpoints.clear(); } else this.resyncBreakpoints();
    this.needsRestart = false;
  }
  step(): RunResult {
    if (!this.built) return this.emptyResult('error', 'No program built yet');
    if (this.needsRestart) return this.emptyResult('restart-needed', 'Restart needed');
    const ip = this.cpu.ip;
    if (ip >= this.parsed.instrs.length) return this.emptyResult('end', 'At end of program');
    const before = this.snapshotRegs();
    this.cpu.intOutput = (s: string) => {};
    this.ex.step();
    const after = this.snapshotRegs();
    const regDiff = diffRegs(before, after);
    const cellId = this.lineOwner[this.parsed.instrs[ip]?.lineNum - 1] ?? null;
    const expectResults = cellId ? this.evalExpects(cellId) : [];
    return { reason: this.cpu.halted ? 'halted' : 'cell-end', steps: 1, output: '', regDiff, halted: !!this.cpu.halted, expectResults, allPassed: expectResults.every((r: ExpectResult) => r.passed) };
  }
  continueRun(): RunResult {
    if (!this.built) return this.emptyResult('error', 'No program built yet');
    if (this.needsRestart) return this.emptyResult('restart-needed', 'Restart needed');
    const before = this.snapshotRegs();
    const outBuf: string[] = [];
    this.cpu.intOutput = (s: string) => outBuf.push(s);
    let steps = 0; const CAP = 200000; let reason: RunResult['reason'] = 'end';
    while (steps < CAP) {
      const ip = this.cpu.ip;
      if (ip >= this.parsed.instrs.length) { reason = 'end'; break; }
      if (this.breakpoints.has(ip)) { reason = 'breakpoint'; break; }
      this.ex.step(); steps++;
      if (this.cpu.halted) { reason = 'halted'; break; }
    }
    if (steps >= CAP) reason = 'cap';
    const after = this.snapshotRegs();
    const regDiff = diffRegs(before, after);
    const ip = Math.min(this.cpu.ip, this.parsed.instrs.length - 1);
    const cellId = this.parsed.instrs[ip] ? this.lineOwner[this.parsed.instrs[ip].lineNum - 1] ?? null : null;
    const expectResults = cellId ? this.evalExpects(cellId) : [];
    return { reason, steps, output: outBuf.join(''), regDiff, halted: !!this.cpu.halted, expectResults, allPassed: expectResults.every((r: ExpectResult) => r.passed) };
  }
  private emptyResult(reason: RunResult['reason'], error: string): RunResult {
    return { reason, error, steps: 0, output: '', regDiff: {}, halted: false, expectResults: [], allPassed: true };
  }
  private snapshotRegs(): Record<string, number> {
    const r: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const k of [...REG_LIST, 'CS', 'DS', 'ES', 'SS']) r[k] = this.cpu.getReg(k);
    r['IP'] = this.cpu.ip; return r;
  }
'''
